confirmedFindings.currentLocation: Both PDFs, petition execution block p2; builder SPEC.components[0].body; guide signing step 4
confirmedFindings.finding: The instrument calls itself VERIFIED but contains only an unsigned DATE/SIGNATURE line and personal-signing instructions. There is no certification, oath, affirmation or penalty-of-perjury language anywhere in either four-page PDF. The settled Sept11 rule requires a 735 ILCS 5/1-109 certification; adding a notary requirement would contradict that rule.
confirmedFindings.bindingRule: Use a 735 ILCS 5/1-109 certification under penalty of perjury. Do not require notarization unless a route-specific statute or rule expressly overrides Section 1-109.
confirmedFindings.repairAcceptance: Include the settled certification in the actual petition execution block, covering the participant-supplied factual allegations, and align signing guidance. Leave actual signature/date blank; do not certify invented personal facts.
confirmedFindings.historicalStatus: Historical VF07 COMPONENT_SET FAIL independently reconfirmed on identical PDF bytes; not superseded.
